provenance.phase: A: verification times only: shutdown 30..32 s, attached coast to 34 s, zero-impulse separation at 34 s, both branches tracked to 36 s. These are not Falcon 9 MECO or staging times.
provenance.initial_state: A: stationary structural base at the initial ground origin, initially vertical Body +x. Nominal literature propellant loading at release; not a reconstructed flight.
provenance.step_s: A: 0.02 s shared truth interval; not a measured sensor sampling requirement.
provenance.propulsion: E/A: Pezent 2024 Table 2.16: per-engine Tvac=914 kN, Isp_vac=311 s, Ae=0.68 m2. Fixed Isp and area, q=throttle*Tvac/(Isp_vac*g0), T=throttle*Tvac-Ae*p(h).
provenance.atmosphere: E/A: standard dry troposphere, T0=288.15 K, p0=101325 Pa, lapse=0.0065 K/m, R=287.05287 J/(kg K), gamma=1.4. Local geometric height approximates geopotential height. Range 0..11 km; no actual weather.
provenance.aero_area: E: 21.08 m2 from Pezent Table 2.18 for the full stack; kept with that coefficient convention.
provenance.drag_coefficient: E/A: approximate raster digitization of Pezent Fig 2.13(b), printed p.76 / PDF p.93, with piecewise-linear interpolation over Mach 0..7. Source geometry: RasAeroII at zero AoA with a 5.2 m fairing. Not original numerical data or flight measurements. Pixel-scale uncertainty and source PDF hash are recorded in data/drag_curve_pezent.json. Applying the curve to this mixed-source vehicle is an assumption.
provenance.aero_moment: A: drag-only force through current CG; no lift, normal-force/aero-moment model or pitch program.
provenance.gravity_wind: A: constant standard-gravity magnitude and zero wind. Gravity direction is updated in current Body as attitude changes; no ENU/ECEF conversion.
provenance.exhaust: A: nine equal flows, fixed coplanar exit station x=0, existing 1.3 m engine ring, uniform exit disks; no gimbal or internal swirl.
provenance.imu: A: virtual fixed sensor at the structural base [0,0,0]; not the measured Falcon 9 IMU location. Outputs are ideal; C adds sensor errors.
provenance.scope: A event/state-map verification only. No actual mission timing, physical separation actuator, free-flight liquid model, stage-2 ignition or mission validation.
provenance.attitude_check: A: verification load only, not a physical wind/actuator model. At fixed station [1,0,0] m, Fy=10000*sin(2*pi*(t-10)/4)^3 N for 10<t<14 s and zero otherwise. Peak 10 kN is about 0.13 percent of initial total thrust; chosen to exercise small-angle rotation without changing engine flow. Both lobes and endpoints are integration breakpoints.
provenance.comparison_imu: A: second virtual IMU at fixed station [40,0,0] m for checking rotation lever-arm effects. Both sensor locations are arbitrary verification stations, not surveyed flight hardware.
provenance.angle_of_attack_limit: A: stop with an error above 3 degrees AoA. This is a selected small-angle verification limit, not validation of the zero-AoA drag curve at nonzero AoA.
provenance.shutdown: A: C2-continuous quintic amplitude a=1-10u^3+15u^4-6u^5 over 2 s scales both nominal ambient-corrected thrust and mass flow. Analytic da/dt supplies dq/dt. Not a measured engine transient, and not steady operation below the minimum throttle.
provenance.separation: A: engines off, no separation impulse, no discarded interstage mass, and the existing assumed contiguous-stage cut at original station 42.6 m. Structural point positions/velocities preserved; child CG states mapped separately. Mass, momentum, kinetic energy audited.
provenance.post_separation: A: gravity-only diagnostic coasts, no child drag/normal forces, frozen last liquid distributions and no fluid re-settling/slosh. Full-stack aerodynamic coefficients are not transferred to separated vehicles. This is a state-map verification surrogate, not a low-altitude coast flight prediction.
provenance.upper_sensor: A: independent virtual IMU at the upper-stack own structural base [0,0,0]; original base IMU stays on booster. Streams must be distinguished by vehicle_id.
